ZONING MAP AMENDMENT TYPE 1 NARRATIVE

                             AND PLANS AT 601-611 S. California Ave.

                                  REZONE FROM 1\A1-2 to C3-2



1A. Narrative

This existing building is located at 601-611 S. California Avenue. lt includes a retailspace at611
S. California Avenue that was formerly a restaurant. The applicant wishes to apply for a Special
Use permit to propose an Adult Use Cannabis Business, specifically a retail "dispensary"
location, for this former restaurant space.

Currently, the building use includes the empty retail/restaurant space, as well as separate office
space for nonprofits and businesses. lt is a two story, 11,900 square foot Brick Building situated
on an approximately 7,000 square feet lot. No on-site parking. The building height is 27.5 feet.
There are no dwelling units. There ate zero set backs.

The property is currently zoned as an M1-2, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District.

For the purposes of our project, we are asking to amend the current zoning of this property from
M1-2, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District to C3-2, Commercial, Manufacturing and
Employment District. This amendment is needed, as M1-2 does not allow for the special uses
required for a cannabis business organization.

The existing structure will require no changes and the inside of the tenant space may be
minimally renovated to meet our operational requirements.
